implementation: Split an unreviewed bound horizontal header only when existing recognition identifies a one-letter boundary token and original ink shows one compact edge component separated from its neighboring word by more than the shorter ink height. Protect human decisions, numeric and other explicit contexts, and competing text. Read glyph and word in separate batches without supplied characters or roles. Replace the composite only if both reads succeed and are nonempty; numeric misreads cannot become calibration ticks. Preserve earlier batches and advance OCR/workflow cache identity.
candidate_selection: Retain V44/English/V27/V5. V46/server remains closed development context, not selected or approved.
license_review: New changes retain Apache-2.0 headers. No dependency, weight or license term changed. Model payloads, manifests, reviewed licenses and notices were checksum verified.
limitations: Requires a recognized single-letter boundary token and a wide original-pixel gap. Tight, ambiguous and unrecognized composites remain unchanged.
A successful nonempty crop may still be misread. Changed literal readings and roles are scored, with every earlier correct reading retained in this evaluation.
The same fixed OCR and marker models remain below overall project requirements. No private/sealed reads, optimizer, production activation or packaged build. Build 433 stays 0.4.33.
